title: Understanding the Logistic Regression Model
text: In logistic regression, the probability that a student prefers Kendrick is calculated using the logistic function. This function takes the form: $$\frac{1}{1+e^{\left(-z\right)}}$$, where $$z$$ is the linear combination of the features and parameters. Can you identify what $$z$$ would be for student s?

title: Calculating the Linear Combination
text: For student s, the linear combination $$z$$ is calculated as: $$z=\theta_0+\theta_1 X_{s1}+\theta_2 X_{s2}$$. Given $$theta=(-2, 2, 1)$$, $$X_{s1}=1$$, and $$X_{s2}=0$$, what is the value of $$z$$?

title: Evaluating the Probability
text: Once you have calculated $$z$$, substitute it into the logistic function: $$\frac{1}{1+e^{\left(-z\right)}}$$. This will give you the probability that student s prefers Kendrick. How does this probability compare to the threshold of $$0.3$$?

title: Classifying the Student's Preference
text: Based on the probability you calculated, which rapper would student s be classified as preferring if the threshold is $$0.3$$?
